GPT-3 comes in eight sizes, ranging from 125M to 175B parameters. The largest GPT-3 model is an order of magnitude larger than the previous record holder, T5-11B. The largest Llama 3.1 model is larger than GPT-3: **Llama 3.1 (405B) = 405 billion parameters** [S5], versus **GPT-3 (largest model) = 175 billion parameters** [S11][S8].  

**Difference:** 405B − 175B = **230 billion parameters**.
